name: Order of the Champion (Cavalier Order)
body:
A cavalier who belongs to this order has pledged themselves to being a champion of people and an inspiration to others.

They go out of their way to be valiant to inspire their allies and protect them from harm.

Edicts: You must not sacrifice your allies to preserve yourself, you must put your life on the line to protect others, and must strive to be worthy of song and tale.

Challenge: Whenever you issue a challenge, you receive a +2 bonus to Will saves against effects made by the target of your challenge. This bonus increases by +1 for every two cavalier levels you possess.

Skills: You add Intimidate and Knowledge (nobility) to your list of class skills. You gain a bonus equal to 1/2 your class level on Intimidate checks made to demoralize an enemy.

Order Abilities: You belong to the order of the champion and gain the following abilities as you increase in level.

Champion’s Shield (Ex)

At 2nd level, you can provide aid another to AC as a swift action and that aid another bonus is doubled when used to boost the AC of an ally.

Inspire Valor (Su)

At 8th level, you can give a bolstering speech to your allies as a swift action. While the speech is maintained as a swift action each round, all allies within 30 feet of you gain a +1 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls and a +2 on Will saves against fear, charm, and compulsion effects. This benefit lasts for 5 rounds after you cease maintaining the ability.

This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

This effect ends if you are killed or unconscious.

Last stand (Ex)

At 15th level, when using inspire valor, all affected allies, including yourself, gain 2d10 temporary hit points and the attack and damage bonus increases to +2.
